_meta.purpose: Identified historical shocks to the output gap, in percentage points per quarter. Fed to the dynamic simulation so the propagation mechanism can be tested separately from crisis prediction — the model cannot and should not forecast a financial crisis from within.
_meta.note: Magnitudes for the 2011 floods and COVID come from the estimated dummies in ESTIMATION_OUTPUT.txt (-7.75 and -2.56 on the gap). AFC and GFC magnitudes are judgemental, shaped to the observed contraction profile. In the game these become shock cards (DESIGN section 10.4).
_meta.units: percentage points added to the output gap in that quarter
_meta.investment_note: Separate investment-rate shocks. Financial crises collapse investment through balance sheets and credit, not through the output gap: in 1998 private GFCF fell to 10.8% of GDP while the demand shock alone explains only part of it.
